_readme: Free-to-play settings for the Google Play build. Edit freely. Lives: a match costs one life when it starts and gives it back if you win, so only losses and quits cost you. Lives refill on a real-time clock. Gems are the premium currency: earned slowly by playing, bought with real money. Nothing in the game is random for money: no loot boxes, every price is shown up front. Ads: rewarded ads are always optional and say what you get; interstitials only between matches, never before a story memory, and never for players who bought Remove Ads or any gem pack. product ids must match the in-app products you create in Play Console.

products.name: Starter Pack
products.desc: 200 gems, 1,500 tips, the Felt-rim paddle and 6 power-ups. Once per player.

products.name: Remove Ads
products.desc: No more ads between matches. Optional reward ads stay available.

products.name: VIP Lounge Pass
products.desc: 8 max lives, lives refill twice as fast, +20% tips from every match, and no ads between matches.
